notes: The 0.31 and 0.44 EUR/kWh subscriber values are arithmetic derivations from the official public prices and official subscription discounts, not separately quoted tariffs.
The 0.20 EUR/min component is an occupancy/post-charge fee triggered by remaining connected after charge end; it is not an energy charging-time price.
Third-party RFID/eMSP retail pricing must remain separate from SIED 70 direct pricing.
summaryLines: SIED 70 current grid is effective from 1 July 2026 in Haute-Saône.
Direct accelerated <50 kW: 0.36 EUR/kWh; after charge end, 30 minutes grace then 0.20 EUR/min, with no penalty from 22:00 to 08:00.
Direct rapid >=50 kW: 0.54 EUR/kWh; 0.20 EUR/min immediately after charge end while the vehicle remains connected.
Haute-Saône resident subscription: 2.99 EUR/month with proof of address; discounts 0.05 EUR/kWh accelerated and 0.10 EUR/kWh rapid, yielding 0.31 and 0.44 EUR/kWh respectively.
Bank-card payment is available on every station; RFID, smartphone/Electromaps and roaming access are also supported.
Roaming/eMSP retail prices remain separate from SIED 70 direct tariffs.
